tools.name: prepare_sauna_quote_request
tools.description: Validate a draft sauna project request and identify missing details. This is read-only: it does not store data, send email, select a provider, or share contact details.

tools.name: submit_sauna_quote_request
tools.description: Store a complete sauna project request and send confirmation and internal notification emails. Call only after prepare_sauna_quote_request and after the user explicitly approves submission. This never subscribes the user to a newsletter and never shares contact details with providers.

tools.name: find_sauna_brands
tools.description: Shortlist up to three sauna brands using heat type, placement, optional group size and optional sauna-only USD budget. No contact details required. tools.name: compare_sauna_brands
tools.description: Compare two or three brands by exact Sauna Guide slug. Returns public editorial fit, caveats, price scope and dates, warranty, recall information and sponsorship disclosures. Use slugs from find_sauna_brands or the brand directory. Brand ranges can include heaters or portable models; never present t

tools.name: estimate_sauna_total_cost
tools.description: Estimate US planning costs in USD using Sauna Guide price benchmarks and installation ranges. Explicit site assumptions are required; ask before choosing them. Returns missing unpriced work and data confidence. A range is not a contractor quote, national average or guarantee. Never call an add-ons-o

tools.name: check_sauna_quote
tools.description: Check an anonymized US sauna quote total and scope for missing costs and questions to ask the seller. No upload, storage, email or contact details required. Omitted scope items are unclear, never assumed included. Report unpriced risks; the projected range is incomplete when unpriced work remains. T

tools.description: Estimate electric heater kW from room dimensions, glass area, wall insulation and supply voltage using the same calculator as Sauna Guide. Ask for actual measurements. Metric is meters and square meters; imperial is feet and square feet. A planning estimate, not approval of wiring, clearances or a p

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prepare_sauna_quote_request, check_sauna_quote · Private data: prepare_sauna_quote_request, submit_sauna_quote_request, find_sauna_brands, check_sauna_quote · Public sink: prepare_sauna_quote_request, submit_sauna_quote_request, check_sauna_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prepare_sauna_quote_request, check_sauna_quote · Private data: prepare_sauna_quote_request, submit_sauna_quote_request, find_sauna_brands, check_sauna_quote · Public sink: prepare_sauna_quote_request, submit_sauna_quote_request, check_sauna_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
